spec.claim_summary: A 4h RSI(14) ladder buys when RSI drops below 28 with five scaled averaging orders and takes profit 3% above average entry with no stop loss.
spec.untestable_reason: The core is a five-rung DCA averaging ladder with 1.8x size scaling that cannot be expressed as single-position rules.
assumptions: Asset not named in claim text; assumed BTCUSDT from page context about BTC.
Direction not stated; assumed long because averaging orders are below entry and take-profit is above average entry.
Entry phrase 'drops below 28' compiled as RSI(14) crosses_below 28 on bar close.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: five averaging orders at -2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25% with 1.8x size scaling per rung and take-profit 3% above average entry; single-position engine cannot average down or compute average entry.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Stop Loss None with ladder allocation as structural risk cap means no fixed stop; left as no stop.
Test window and starting flat position are not part of the rule; cited period stored in claimed.

evidence.quote: Net Profit: +3,078.29 USDT (+3.08%) … Percent Profitable: 70.97% (44 / 62) … Profit Factor: 4.028

audit_majors: testable: Marks claim untestable because five-rung DCA ladder with 1.8x scaling cannot be expressed, but a mechanical single-position core could be tested: 4h RSI(14) crosses_below 28 entry with 3% take-profit above entry and no stop-loss; 1.8x scaling is position sizing which is out of scope and averaging rungs could be simplified via assumptions.
